deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the framework adopts a different distribution channel than a self-hosted Claude Code plugin marketplace (the same criterion as build_plugin.py).
description: The version-monotonicity-on-content-change anchor for the shipped plugin lib (#355). `version` is the last RELEASED _PLUGIN_VERSION and `lib_digest` is the deterministic sha256 over the committed plugins/auto-maintainer/lib/ tree AT that release (each *.py file's basename + NUL + bytes + NUL, in sorted-name order, .pyc excluded). The release-lib guard (test_shipped_lib_change_requires_version_bump) recomputes the CURRENT committed lib digest: if it equals `lib_digest` the shipped lib is unchanged and any version is fine; if it differs the shipped lib changed, so _PLUGIN_VERSION MUST have advanced past `version`. A same-version content change (the #350 marketplace-invisible drift) therefore fails the guard. An operator cutting a release bumps _PLUGIN_VERSION AND re-anchors both fields here (version -> new version, lib_digest -> the new committed-lib digest), exactly as the doc/e2e baselines are re-anchored.
